generation.notes: Written by a sub-agent of the orchestrating Claude Code session, from the application-batch brief. NumPy only; spectral subtraction over a short-time Fourier transform of size resolution with a fixed hop of 8 ms, the noise level of every frequency taken from the quietest fifth of the frames. One item takes about 16 ms at default settings, 4 ms at the lightest and 65 ms at the heaviest; a steady tone counts as background and is removed with the noise.
